question: A school records the number of Mathematics and Physics reference books issued to students of Sections A, B and C as follows: Section A: 18 and 12, Section B: 15 and 14, Section C: 20 and 11, respectively. Represent this information by a matrix taking sections as rows and subjects as columns. Also state what the entry in the third row and second column represents.
explanation:
Arrangement by rows and columns
The three sections form the three rows, while Mathematics and Physics form the two columns.
Matrix representation
$$A=\begin{bmatrix}18 & 12 \\ 15 & 14 \\ 20 & 11\end{bmatrix}$$
Interpretation of the entry
The entry in the third row and second column is $a_{32}=11$. It represents the number of Physics reference books issued to Section C.

options.A: $$\begin{bmatrix}18&15&20\\12&14&11\end{bmatrix}$$; the entry $a_{32}=11$ represents Mathematics books issued to Section C.
options.B: $$\begin{bmatrix}12&18\\14&15\\11&20\end{bmatrix}$$; the entry $a_{32}=20$ represents Physics books issued to Section C.
options.C: $$\begin{bmatrix}18&12\\15&14\\20&11\end{bmatrix}$$; the entry $a_{32}=11$ represents Physics reference books issued to Section C.
options.D: $$\begin{bmatrix}18&12\\20&11\\15&14\end{bmatrix}$$; the entry $a_{32}=11$ represents Physics books issued to Section B.
